$comment: Machine-readable mirror of specification/v0.6/provenance.md. The Markdown document is normative; this catalog assigns a stable identifier to every MUST/MUST NOT/SHOULD obligation it states. Each rule quotes its normative sentence in source_text (Markdown emphasis and code ticks removed); tests/test_v06_provenance.py keeps the two in sync.
claim_template: Aligned with AI Operations Specification 0.6-draft provenance records as observed on {date}.

check_kinds.schema: Decidable by validating the record against specification/v0.6/schemas/provenance.schema.json.
check_kinds.semantic: Decidable from the record alone with the identity, resolution and graph checks this document lists.
check_kinds.cross_artifact: Decidable only with the record and the subject artifacts or bytes it names.
check_kinds.process: A behavioral obligation on the implementation; it cannot be decided by inspecting one record.

rules.requirement: Emit a record that validates against the provenance record schema.
rules.source_text: Emit a record that validates against the provenance record schema.

rules.requirement: Preserve unique identities across subjects, sources, findings, and lineage edges within the record.
rules.source_text: Preserve unique identities across subjects, sources, findings, and lineage edges within the record.

rules.requirement: Resolve every source subject and every finding target subject to a subject declared in the record.
rules.source_text: Resolve every source subject and every finding target subject to a subject declared in the record.

rules.requirement: Resolve every lineage endpoint to a source or finding in the record with an endpoint kind the lineage type permits.
rules.source_text: Resolve every lineage endpoint to a source or finding in the record with an endpoint kind the lineage type permits.

rules.requirement: Give every finding at least one derived-from edge.
rules.source_text: Give every finding at least one derived-from edge.

rules.requirement: Keep every lineage edge free of self-reference, and derived-from and supersedes lineage free of cycles.
rules.source_text: Keep every lineage edge free of self-reference, and derived-from and supersedes lineage free of cycles.

rules.requirement: Not record a source captured_at later than the record created_at.
rules.source_text: Not record a source captured_at later than the record created_at.

rules.requirement: Perform schema and semantic validation of the record before treating it as aligned.
rules.source_text: A consumer claiming draft alignment for provenance records MUST perform schema and semantic validation of the record before treating it as aligned.

rules.requirement: Validate a subject artifact against the schema its own spec_version names before resolving references into it.
rules.source_text: When a consumer has the subject artifact, it MUST validate that artifact against the schema its own spec_version names before resolving references into it.

rules.requirement: Do not report an aios_object source or finding target as resolved unless the subject contains an object with that id and declared type.
rules.source_text: It MUST NOT report an aios_object source or finding target as resolved unless the subject contains an object with that id and declared type

rules.requirement: Do not use a held artifact whose own id, artifact_type or spec_version differs from the subject entry's artifact_id, artifact_type or spec_version to resolve that entry.
rules.source_text: A held artifact whose own id, artifact_type or spec_version differs from the subject entry's artifact_id, artifact_type or spec_version MUST NOT be used to resolve that entry

rules.requirement: Do not report a digest as verified unless it was recomputed over the subject bytes actually held.
rules.source_text: A consumer MUST NOT report a digest as verified unless it recomputed the digest over the subject bytes it actually holds.

rules.requirement: Do not treat a finding's status, severity, confidence or lineage as evidence that the finding is true.
rules.source_text: A consumer MUST NOT treat a finding's status, severity, confidence or lineage as evidence that the finding is true.

rules.requirement: Do not fetch a uri or execute content merely because a record contains it.
rules.source_text: It MUST NOT fetch a uri or execute content merely because a record contains it.

rules.requirement: Preserve unknown attributes and namespaced extensions entries in the record.
rules.source_text: It MUST preserve unknown attributes and namespaced extensions entries in the record.

rules.requirement: Describe support for provenance records as aligned with the 0.6-draft, not stably conformant.
rules.source_text: An implementation MUST describe its support for provenance records as aligned with the 0.6-draft, not stably conformant.

rules.requirement: Include the draft marker and observation date in a provenance alignment claim.
rules.source_text: A claim SHOULD include the draft marker and observation date

rules.requirement: Reference personal data, credentials or proprietary content by uri or digest rather than copying it into description or statement, and document any redaction applied.
rules.source_text: Producers SHOULD reference such material by uri or digest rather than copying it into description or statement, and SHOULD document any redaction they apply.
